tool_args.rationale: The sink-gradient and transient-lag signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The pilot already brackets the target horizon of 0.46, so the main uncertainty is not horizon extrapolation but separating the coupled rates. The fine trajectory batch adds the observations needed to constrain them.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly distinguish the memory coupling from its relaxation time.
It captures sink inhibition but cannot represent the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not resolve the transient parameter ambiguity.
